mapper.select: select cxr.INSIDE_CODE LINING_CODE, /*内衬代码*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY*cxr.INSIDE_LENGTH/1000),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN_CONSUME /*成型今日早班计划*/ from ( SELECT r.EMBRYO_CODE, r.BOM_DATA_VERSION, max(ci.INSIDE_CODE) INSIDE_CODE, /*内衬代码*/ max(ci.INSIDE_LENGTH) INSIDE_LENGTH, /*胎侧长*/ sum(IFNULL(r.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(r.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) CLASS1_PLAN_QTY /*成型今日早班计划计划量*/ FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT r inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on r.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and r.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and r.DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY r.EMBRYO_CODE,r.BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ group by cxr.INSIDE_CODE

select MATERIAL_CODE liningCode, SUM(IFNULL(STOCK_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(BAD_NUM, 0)) STOCK_NUM from T_NC_STOCK where STOCK_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{stockDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) /*排程日期 要减1天，才是对应库存日期*/ and DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY MATERIAL_CODE
SELECT LINING_CODE, IFNULL(SUM(night_plan_qty), 0) consume FROM T_NC_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY LINING_CODE
